cells.gaps: The count of N-ATLAS collaborators and certified applications (NGA-025) is a presenter's figure at a NITDA consultation, with no date range; no user of national AI computing is named or counted.
cells.note: Udu Technologies runs GPU servers in Nigeria (NGA-002), N-ATLAS was released open source in 2025 (NGA-011), and in November 2026 it counted more than 140 registered collaborators and 18 certified third-party applications (NGA-025), so its users are counted. Stage 5 is the top rung.
